name: Nere
backstory: Nere, also known as True Soul Nere, is a True Soul of the Absolute, and potential boss in Baldur's Gate 3. He is a pivotal character for the quests Free True Soul Nere, Save the Grymforge Gnomes and Deliver Nere's Head.
